retry_5xx.why: retries 429 and every 5xx, the usual default, instead of only 429 and 503

four_retries.why: reads at most 4 attempts as 4 retries: 5 attempts, waits 0.5, 1, 2, 4

backoff_from_1s.why: doubles from 1 s (1, 2, 4) instead of from 0.5 s

gave_up_error.why: raises its own error after the last attempt instead of the last HTTP error
